program.name: Pump Before the Date
program.subject: Strip & show-off
program.blurb: Twenty minutes before you go out: chest, shoulders and arms full of blood, abs lit, a body built to fuck her in.
program.about: A pump, not a workout to recover from, so you look worth her hands and her mouth when your clothes come off. Supersets of presses, flies, raises and curls with short rests fill the muscles that show, and a fast abs finisher tightens the middle. Do it an hour before the date, shower, and walk in looking your best. Level II adds reps, Level III asks for heavier weights.
